Tighter texture atlases, an optional `--rotate`, and an `install.sh` whose binary survives `cargo clean`.

- **Best-of packing:** `atlas` now tries several MaxRects placement heuristics (best short side, best area, bottom-left, contact point) and several sort orders (longest side, area, height, width, perimeter), and keeps the layout with the fewest pages, then the least page area, with the last page shrunk toward a square. Layouts differ from 0.10.x but stay deterministic: the same inputs give the same bytes. On sample unit sheets, total page area dropped by 1.5% to 8.4%.
- **`--rotate`:** off by default. Lets packing turn sprites 90° clockwise where that packs tighter. Rotated frames say `"rotated": true` in the TexturePacker hash JSON and keep their unturned `w` and `h`. PixiJS draws them upright; Phaser 3 doesn't support rotated frames (it draws them mirrored), so leave `--rotate` off for Phaser.
- **`install.sh` copies the binary:** it installs a copy of `codex-img` into `~/.local/bin` (or `$BIN_DIR`) instead of a symlink into `target/`, so the install survives `cargo clean`. Re-run `./scripts/install.sh` after pulling a new version.
